title: Improving the conversion of petroleum coke to solid acid catalysts – effectiveness of hydrogen peroxide and impact of silica contamination
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,45453-45466
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05900C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Natalia Mariano Cabral, Josephine M. Hill
Petcoke was functionalized to solid acid catalysts. H2O2 produced more active catalysts than HNO3. High SiO2 content improved esterification by reducing particle size and diffusion. Activity is more dependent on total acidity than –SO3H density.
